title: Caption-aware ripple TrimClip
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: On the generic (no audio-track) path, TrimClip(ripple:true) now reuses the RippleTrimClip caption and marker interval crop/split/shift instead of refusing CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Media mutation stays on the existing generic ripple-trim path; an in trim still pins timeline start.

A spanning cue keeps authored text; the portion before the closed interval stays, the portion inside is cropped, and the portion after is shifted. A uniquely covered clipLocal cue that still sits on the host follows that host. Source uncover is whole-group ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. A locked caption track is FIELD_LOCKED. Out-trim caption geometry matches RippleTrimClip on a video-only document (remnant ids may differ).

A real UI path imports a video-only clip (no persistent audio extract, so Trim is ripple), adds a spanning cue, ripple-trims 15 frames off the out edge, undoes and redoes that command, archives a fork, exports a VTT sidecar, and still refuses preview/MP4 burn-in.

Leave-gap TrimClip(ripple:false) still does not shift later content and still leaves an absolute remnant in the vacated gap. On a document with a persistent audio track, TrimClip(ripple:true) still refuses CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED (not rewritten as LINKED_RIPPLE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED). Lifting a clipLocal-marker host is still REF_NOT_FOUND. The table 0.02s AV offset is off the 30 fps grid and still refuses OFF_FRAME_GRID; alignment stays 1/30 s.

Already-delivered leave-gap, single-range ripple delete/close, shorten and lengthen RippleTrimClip, reject/overwrite/insert, includeLinks=false, insert-move leave-gap, caption default clipLocal / follow / interval / source-window, split and leave-gap rebind/remnants, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. No silent caption or marker drop. No MP4 burn-in. No new persistence table. Auto-close is not a MoveClips mode.

Not auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, I-006 roll/slip/slide, source-interval crop, field-aware inverse, marker sidecar formats, linked-audio ripple trim, or the full section-3 matrix.
I-005 and I-010 remain partial; 87 count and XD10 stay separately counted. Intermittent underrun, old-writer schema9 as a product qualification, and other-end GPU physical sync remain unproven.
